svg.aria-label: Which experts does each kind of traffic light up?
svg.text: Which experts does each kind of traffic light up?
GLM-5.2, 75 instrumented MoE layers (3-77) x 256 experts, live TP4 serve; MTP78 calibration corpus replayed one axis at a time
ONE colour scale, shared by every panel, never auto-scaled:
domain = [-4.000, +4.000] = [0.0625×, 16×] of uniform share, in 9 equal bands
columns = pooled order, perm sha256 008b76b58f20 — the SAME permutation in every panel · signal = count
SYNTHETIC LAYOUT PREVIEW · hatched panels are FABRICATED placeholder data, not measured routing
A axis1_general — SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER, NOT MEASURED
Σ 142.50M assignments · max 19.4× uniform · layer entropy min/med 0.935/0.958 · never routed 0 · clipped below 0 / above 2
B axis2_legal — SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER, NOT MEASURED
Σ 247.50M assignments · max 19.6× uniform · layer entropy min/med 0.921/0.960 · never routed 0 · clipped below 0 / above 3
Σ 69.99M assignments · max 27.9× uniform · layer entropy min/med 0.804/0.889 · never routed 0 · clipped below 752 / above 25
D axis4_reasoning_termination — SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER, NOT MEASURED
Σ 300.00M assignments · max 18.8× uniform · layer entropy min/med 0.935/0.958 · never routed 0 · clipped below 0 / above 2
R reference quant — the experts a human promoted to K4
same rows, same columns as the panels above — read it against them, not on its own
magnitude — share of the layer’s routing in multiples of uniform (1× = its fair share of the 256)
Pairwise overlap of the hottest experts (mean per-layer Jaccard)
top-N per layer at the reference’s own cardinality (n_k4 min/median/max 50/108/108), 75 layers · chance floor 0.2652 · identical traffic reads 1.000
DIFFERENT: axes select substantially different experts (mean pairwise 0.340 vs chance 0.265, 1.28x chance; range
What this hides, stated so it cannot be read wrong: the panels show SHARE, not volume — a burst and a soak look the same, so the per-panel Σ is printed
The columns are SORTED (pooled), so the left-to-right gradient is the sort, not a finding; what is readable is how far each panel departs from that
order. Same column = same expert in every panel, per layer — expert id is not on the x axis, the permutation is in the JSON sidecar.
count is the collector’s exponentially-decayed window (defaults λ=0.95 over 64 slots of 32 steps ≈ the last 2,048 engine steps), not a lifetime total.
Gate-mass provenance, read from the dump’s flag and never inferred from the arrays: n/a (signal=count).
PLACEHOLDER PANELS (fabricated, layout review only): axis1_general, axis2_legal, axis4_reasoning_termination. Every number above that involves them is
meaningless. Collect the real dumps with heatmap/CAPTURE-RECIPE.md.
